summary: The subset defines strong fail-closed scanner, artifact, approval, and verification contracts, but the raw-ARIA fallback does not enforce its documented DNS-snapshot continuity, creating a material trust-boundary gap. Public manifests and snapshot-only fallback guidance also omit important operational qualifications.

findings.title: Raw-ARIA navigation is not bound to the approved DNS snapshot
findings.evidence: The request guard calls assertSafeNavigation and then continues based only on scheme, hostname, port, and credentials. The helper receives no approved peer set and performs no DNS drift check, despite the generator contract requiring the fallback to emit no snapshot when the approved address snapshot drifts. A localhost hostname can therefore be resolved again between preflight and browser dispatch without enforcement of the preflight identity.
findings.recommendation: Pass the validated peer snapshot into the helper and enforce it at the browser transport boundary, or restrict this fallback to literal 127.0.0.1 and ::1 targets where DNS cannot drift.

findings.title: Plugin manifest overstates live-exploration scope
findings.evidence: The public plugin description advertises generation with live browser exploration without limiting it to local/disposable or externally isolated approved non-production targets. The included generator contract makes shared, production, and unknown remote targets snapshot-only.
findings.recommendation: Qualify live exploration in every manifest as available only for eligible local/disposable or isolated approved non-production targets.

findings.title: Required snapshot sanitization is not actionable
findings.evidence: The sole fallback for shared, production, or unknown remote targets asks users for sanitized DOM/accessibility snapshots, but the included guidance supplies no sanitization checklist, schema, command, or validator defining what must be removed.
findings.recommendation: Provide a bounded sanitization procedure covering credentials, cookies, tokens, query values, personal data, and application secrets, with a fail-closed validator or concrete checklist.

limitations: Packet-only static review; no tools, execution, filesystem inspection, network access, or subagents were used.
Omitted tests, holdouts, benchmarks, prior reviews, repository history, and runtime results were not treated as evidence.
This subset review is not full product coverage, skill-accuracy measurement, independent ground truth, human or sealed review, or remote model attestation.
